algorithm.calibration_subset: same first 200 original calibration cache IDs
algorithm.selection_metric: TF token accuracy equally averaged over calibration-frozen ambiguity-band scales, then seeds and sources

ambiguity_band.source: 200 calibration sources, 3 seeds, A1 TF, beta0

algorithm.empty_band: M1 inapplicable for that level; choose lambda=1 without tuning
algorithm.tie_break: smallest lambda among exact accuracy ties
algorithm.probability_only_objective: TF true-token mean log probability, equal scales 7-10 then seeds then sources
algorithm.probability_only_role: log probability and reliability on decision prefixes; cannot change MAP decisions, M1-M3 or image outputs

M1_accuracy.CI: positive paired source-bootstrap 95% against both A1 and A2

M1_original_joint_secondary.additional_requirement: beta0 decision-version true-token logp gain CI positive against both controls; separately reported pending clarification

M2.path_accuracy: equal average of all 10 per-scale path-conditioned accuracies; token-count-weighted accuracy also reported secondarily
M2.latent_error: sum of squared errors ||F-Fq_post||^2 in original latent coordinates
M2.criteria: V minus each control: path accuracy CI strictly positive and latent error CI strictly negative

algorithm.fusion: unchanged precision formula with per-channel calibration variance; each decision/fixed receiver has its own calibration rho
algorithm.fusion_variance_population: 200 fixed calibration sources x 3 seeds x 256 spatial positions per channel per level/receiver
algorithm.clean_latent_use: offline path-conditioned score and latent-error diagnostic only
